ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a predominantly low-intensity (black) background (~75%) with localized high-intensity (white/light grey) regions (~25%) consisting of mottling and scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains high-intensity mottled patches concentrated on the inner proximal area and linear white streaks. Right lobe is predominantly low-intensity (black) with discrete, high-contrast white circular ring structures and thin linear white markings scattered across the distal half.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated interior pixel angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary. Right lobe distal edge shows deeper, more irregular valleys and sharper peaks compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature tapering to sharp, irregular distal tips with significant trailing edge indentations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white ring clusters (approx. 6 distinct rings) visible on the right lobe's distal surface. Smaller white clusters are visible at the extreme tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths, primarily oriented horizontally and diagonally, concentrated near the median notch and central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of suspected barnacle attachment scars (circular rosettes) and odontocete rake marks (parallel linear scratches) across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly prominent, isolated white circular ring scar located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe lobe.
